rows.name: Sphere — Metallica residency
rows.when_open: Residency announced as Jan 28 – Mar 13, 2027 (official show listing)
rows.hours: Show times vary by date; not published on the listing page
rows.exceptions: Tickets sell out; dates subject to change per the venue's own notice ('Event content, dates, times, prices and availability subject to change')
rows.price_basis: Ticket prices vary by date/zone and were not published on the listing page
rows.why_it_matches: In-window: overlaps the entire Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 trip window
rows.transit_note: Venetian/Palazzo is adjacent to the Sphere; Wynn and Resorts World are also within walking distance. No official transit-time figure was retrieved.

rows.name: High Roller Observation Wheel (The LINQ)
rows.when_open: Daily · box office 'Opens 12:30 PM' at check; ride runs daily from 12 PM
rows.hours: Ticket windows: Daily 12–5 PM (daytime) and 12 PM–close (anytime); one rotation takes 30 minutes
rows.exceptions: Outdoor wheel; closed only if weather requires. Happy Half Hour is 21+.
rows.price_2_adults: $47.00 (2 × $23.50 adult daytime, 12–5:59 PM) · $69.50 (2 × $34.75 adult anytime, from 6 PM) · $120 (2 × $60 Happy Half Hour)
rows.price_basis: Exact published adult prices × 2, plus taxes and fees which the page says are extra
rows.why_it_matches: Open every day of the trip
rows.transit_note: Sits on the LINQ Promenade beside the Harrah's / The LINQ Monorail station.

rows.name: The Mob Museum
rows.when_open: Open daily · Museum 9 AM–9 PM · The Underground 11 AM–11 PM (Sun–Thu), 11 AM–midnight (Fri–Sat)
rows.exceptions: Hours subject to change; the museum publishes early closures on its Hours & Directions page
rows.price_2_adults: $75.90 (2 × $37.95 General Admission) · $99.90 (2 × $49.95 Deluxe Pass) · $109.90 (2 × $54.95 Premier Pass)
rows.price_basis: Exact published per-adult prices × 2; the $7 morning/evening online discount is not applied here
rows.why_it_matches: Open daily through the whole window
rows.transit_note: Downtown at 300 Stewart Ave; reachable by RTC bus from the Strip. No official door-to-door time retrieved.

rows.name: The Neon Museum
rows.when_open: Open daily · Sept–May 3 PM–11 PM (last entry 10 PM); Jun–Aug 8 PM–midnight (last entry 11 PM)
rows.hours: Box office closes 1 hour before closing
rows.exceptions: From tickets bought for Jan 1, 2027 onward, daytime and evening tickets are replaced by a single '2027 Admission' valid during operating hours
rows.price_basis: The official page states 'From $21' for 2027 Admission; that is a starting price, not a confirmed price for a specific date.
rows.transit_note: Downtown, 770 Las Vegas Blvd N. No official transit time retrieved.
rows.social_note: These three social accounts are linked directly from the museum's own website footer.

rows.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens
rows.when_open: Lunar New Year display 9 Jan – 6 Mar 2027 · Spring display 13 Mar – 15 May 2027
rows.exceptions: DARK 7–12 Mar 2027 (between installations). Dates may change.
rows.price_basis: Official page states the Conservatory is free to visit
rows.why_it_matches: Lunar New Year display runs the entire preferred Feb 15–18 dates; a short dark window 7–12 Mar falls inside the wider trip window
rows.transit_note: Inside Bellagio on the Center Strip.

rows.name: Fountains of Bellagio
rows.hours: Mon–Fri every 30 min 3:00–7:30 PM, every 15 min 8:00 PM–midnight · Sat/Sun/holidays every 30 min 12:00–7:30 PM, every 15 min 8:00 PM–midnight
rows.exceptions: Schedule may vary; outdoor display subject to cancellation for weather
rows.price_basis: Official page states it is 'absolutely free for any visitor'
rows.why_it_matches: Runs every day of the trip

rows.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
rows.when_open: Scenic Drive open daily; seasonal hours change through the year
rows.hours: Timed-entry reservation required for vehicle entry 1 Oct – 31 May, 8 AM–5 PM
rows.exceptions: Timed entry must be reserved on Recreation.gov or by phone (877) 444-6777. No public transit to the area.
rows.price_basis: Vehicle entry fee not confirmed on the pages retrieved in this session
rows.why_it_matches: Best visited in the cool season — Feb/Mar falls inside the Oct 1–May 31 timed-entry period
rows.transit_note: About 30–45 minutes' drive west of the Strip by car; NO RTC bus service to the canyon — a rental car or rideshare is required. Walking/transit is not an option here.

rows.name: Las Vegas Monorail (getting around)
rows.hours: Mon 7 AM–midnight · Tue–Thu 7 AM–2 AM · Fri–Sun 7 AM–3 AM; trains every 4–8 minutes
rows.exceptions: System notices publish early closures (e.g. several Nov–Dec 2026 dates)
rows.price_basis: Exact published full fares × 2 for two adults; eTicket prices are lower ($5.75 / $13.95 / $30.85 / $59.95)
rows.why_it_matches: Connects 7 Strip stations: MGM Grand · Horseshoe/Paris · Flamingo/Caesars Palace · Harrah's/The LINQ · Boingo at LVCC · Westgate · SAHARA
rows.transit_note: Most useful for covering long Strip distances quickly; does not reach Downtown, Chinatown or the airport.

rows.name: RTC Deuce bus (getting around)
rows.hours: Deuce runs approximately every 15 minutes along the Strip and Downtown
rows.exceptions: F1 construction is changing bus service around the Strip per an RTC alert on its home page
rows.price_basis: Exact published Strip & All Access regular fares × 2
rows.why_it_matches: The only transit that reaches Downtown and Chinatown/Spring Mountain
rows.transit_note: There is NO subway/metro in Las Vegas. Bus + monorail are the public options; trip times must be checked in the RTC trip planner.
